1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.CircularVoronoiSectors
2 
3 /-! The complete Voronoi boundary for source copies on a common circle:
4 the center and exactly the rays bisecting consecutive angular gaps.
5 -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding
8 
9 open Real Set
10 
11 /-- Directions bisecting consecutive gaps, with the closing gap written explicitly. -/
12 def circularGapMidpoints {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (first last : Fin n) : Set ℝ :=
13   {m | (∃ i j : Fin n, j.val = i.val + 1 ∧ m = (θ i + θ j) / 2) ∨
14     m = (θ last + (θ first + 2 * π)) / 2}
15 
16 /-- The list of gap directions is finite. -/
17 theorem circularGapMidpoints_finite {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (first last : Fin n) :
18     (circularGapMidpoints θ first last).Finite := by
19   have pairs := finite_range (fun p : Fin n × Fin n => (θ p.1 + θ p.2) / 2)
20   apply (pairs.union (finite_singleton ((θ last + (θ first + 2 * π)) / 2))).subset
21   rintro m (⟨i, j, _, rfl⟩ | rfl)
22   · exact Or.inl ⟨(i, j), rfl⟩
23   · exact Or.inr rfl
24 
25 /-- All gap midpoints lie strictly within one full turn from the first source. -/
26 theorem circular_midpoint_bounds {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ)
27     (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π) (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0)
28     {m : ℝ} (midpoint : m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last) :
29     θ first < m ∧ m < θ first + 2 * π := by
30   rcases midpoint with ⟨i, j, next, rfl⟩ | rfl
31   · have order := increasing (show i < j by omega)
32     have lower := increasing.monotone (show first ≤ i by omega)
33     constructor <;> linarith [(bounds i).2, (bounds j).2, (bounds first).1]
34   · have order := increasing.monotone (show first ≤ last by omega)
35     constructor <;> linarith [(bounds last).2, (bounds first).1, pi_pos]
36 
37 /-- Two listed positive rays can meet only if both their directions and radii agree. -/
38 theorem circular_gap_ray_unique {n : ℕ} (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ)
39     (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π) (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0)
40     (z : Plane) {m k ρ σ : ℝ} (hm : m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last)
41     (hk : k ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last) (rp : 0 < ρ) (sp : 0 < σ)
42     (same : z + ρ • direction m = z + σ • direction k) : m = k ∧ ρ = σ := by
43   have bm := circular_midpoint_bounds θ increasing bounds first last at_first hm
44   have bk := circular_midpoint_bounds θ increasing bounds first last at_first hk
45   have vectors := add_left_cancel same
46   have angles := polar_angle_eq_of_one_turn ρ σ m k rp sp (by linarith) (by linarith) vectors
47   have radii := congrArg (dist (0 : Plane)) vectors
48   rw [polar_radius ρ m rp.le, polar_radius σ k sp.le] at radii
49   exact ⟨angles, radii⟩
50 
51 /-- Every listed gap midpoint gives a nearest-source tie at every positive radius. -/
52 theorem circular_midpoint_is_boundary {sources : Set Plane} {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ sources)
53     (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ) (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π)
54     (z : Plane) {R : ℝ} (radius_positive : 0 < R)
55     (position : ∀ i, (e i : Plane) = z + R • direction (θ i))
56     (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
57     (two : first < last) {m ρ : ℝ} (midpoint : m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last)
58     (sample_positive : 0 < ρ) : z + ρ • direction m ∈ voronoiBoundary sources := by
59   rcases midpoint with ⟨i, j, next, rfl⟩ | rfl
60   · exact (circular_gap_voronoi_ray sources z radius_positive sample_positive
61       (increasing (by omega)) (by linarith [(bounds i).1, (bounds j).2])
62       (position i ▸ (e i).property) (position j ▸ (e j).property)
63       (circular_order_gap e θ increasing bounds z R position i j next)).2.1
64   · have first_mem : z + R • direction (θ first + 2 * π) ∈ sources := by
65       rw [direction_add_two_pi]
66       exact position first ▸ (e first).property
67     exact (circular_gap_voronoi_ray sources z radius_positive sample_positive
68       (show θ last < θ first + 2 * π by linarith [(bounds last).2, (bounds first).1])
69       (show θ first + 2 * π < θ last + 2 * π by linarith [increasing two])
70       (position last ▸ (e last).property) first_mem
71       (closing_circular_order_gap e θ increasing z R position first last at_first at_last)).2.1
72 
73 /-- There are no additional cut directions between or beyond the listed gap rays. -/
74 theorem circular_boundary_on_listed_ray {sources : Set Plane} {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ sources)
75     (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ) (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π)
76     (z : Plane) {R : ℝ} (radius_positive : 0 < R)
77     (position : ∀ i, (e i : Plane) = z + R • direction (θ i))
78     (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
79     (two : first < last) {x : Plane} (not_center : x ≠ z) (cut : x ∈ voronoiBoundary sources) :
80     ∃ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last, x = z + ρ • direction m := by
81   let ρ := dist x z
82   have positive : 0 < ρ := dist_pos.mpr not_center
83   obtain ⟨φ, low, high, coordinates⟩ := circle_point_angle positive (show dist x z = ρ from rfl)
84   rcases circular_gaps_cover_direction θ increasing bounds first last ⟨low, high⟩ with
85     ⟨i, j, next, in_gap⟩ | ⟨ψ, in_gap, same_direction⟩
86   · have criterion := circular_gap_boundary_iff sources z radius_positive positive
87       (increasing (by omega)) (by linarith [(bounds i).1, (bounds j).2])
88       (position i ▸ (e i).property) (position j ▸ (e j).property)
89       (circular_order_gap e θ increasing bounds z R position i j next) in_gap
90     have midpoint := criterion.mp (coordinates ▸ cut)
91     exact ⟨ρ, positive, φ, Or.inl ⟨i, j, next, midpoint⟩, coordinates⟩
92   · have first_mem : z + R • direction (θ first + 2 * π) ∈ sources := by
93       rw [direction_add_two_pi]
94       exact position first ▸ (e first).property
95     have criterion := circular_gap_boundary_iff sources z radius_positive positive
96       (show θ last < θ first + 2 * π by linarith [(bounds last).2, (bounds first).1])
97       (show θ first + 2 * π < θ last + 2 * π by linarith [increasing two])
98       (position last ▸ (e last).property) first_mem
99       (closing_circular_order_gap e θ increasing z R position first last at_first at_last) in_gap
100     have representation : x = z + ρ • direction ψ := coordinates.trans (by rw [same_direction])
101     have midpoint := criterion.mp (representation ▸ cut)
102     exact ⟨ρ, positive, ψ, Or.inr midpoint, representation⟩
103 
104 /-- Exact equality of the whole diagram with the center and the listed positive rays. -/
105 theorem circular_voronoi_boundary_iff {sources : Set Plane} {n : ℕ} (e : Fin n ≃ sources)
106     (θ : Fin n → ℝ) (increasing : StrictMono θ) (bounds : ∀ i, 0 ≤ θ i ∧ θ i < 2 * π)
107     (z : Plane) {R : ℝ} (radius_positive : 0 < R)
108     (position : ∀ i, (e i : Plane) = z + R • direction (θ i))
109     (first last : Fin n) (at_first : first.val = 0) (at_last : last.val + 1 = n)
110     (two : first < last) (x : Plane) :
111     x ∈ voronoiBoundary sources ↔ x = z ∨
112       ∃ (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ m ∈ circularGapMidpoints θ first last, x = z + ρ • direction m := by
113   constructor
114   · intro cut
115     by_cases center : x = z
116     · exact Or.inl center
117     · exact Or.inr (circular_boundary_on_listed_ray e θ increasing bounds z radius_positive
118         position first last at_first at_last two center cut)
119   · rintro (center | ⟨ρ, positive, m, midpoint, same⟩)
120     · rw [center]
121       have common (p : sources) : dist (p : Plane) z = R := by
122         obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := e.surjective p
123         rw [position i, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_cancel_left, norm_smul, direction_norm, mul_one,
124           Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos radius_positive]
125       refine ⟨e first, (e first).property, e last, (e last).property, ?_,
126         (common (e first)).trans (common (e last)).symm, ?_⟩
127       · intro same
128         exact (ne_of_lt two) (e.injective (Subtype.ext same))
129       · intro p hp
130         rw [common (e first), common ⟨p, hp⟩]
131     · rw [same]
132       exact circular_midpoint_is_boundary e θ increasing bounds z radius_positive position
133         first last at_first at_last two midpoint positive
134 
135 end SixVertexUnfolding
